items.source_class: community wiki, search-engine summary only (page refused automated access)
items.text: When a chance surpasses 100%, the event will occur once for each 100% chance you have, and then have a normal percentage chance to occur again based on the remaining value. For example, a 215% surpassing chance for an event will cause the event to occur twice and have a 15% chance for it to occur a third time.
Supported Skills become usable after you have moved 10 metres. Supported Skills become unusable again after use. Supported Skills have 40% more Skill Speed.
items.finding: The page does not say how distance is counted or whether teleports count.

items.text: Teleport to a enemy and Strike them. Consumes Power Charges to perform additional teleporting Strikes on nearby enemies. Teleports and Strikes 2 additional times per Power Charge, with 285% more Attack Speed. You cannot gain Power Charges while using this Skill.
items.finding: Matches the pinned skill and stat description text. Says nothing on cooldown, timing of the extra strikes, mana per strike or Hit and Run.

items.source_class: official forum, player posts (no GGG staff reply), December 2024 (patch 0.1)
text: Combo is not a global counter. You gain and spend combo separately for each skill. (TrashCondor#0180, 2024-12-03)
you get +1 to the combo count of the skill you attacked with. (staudd#4625, 2024-12-03)
Yes, you can spend from any pool, but the pools are tracked seperately. (staudd#4625, 2024-12-03)
items.finding: Player statements from patch 0.1 about Combo in general; they predate Culmination II, Martial Adept and Martial Master as pinned and say nothing about multi-strike skills.

items.text: Combo is built by successfully Striking Enemies. Combo count will fall off after a short duration of not building or maintaining further Combo.
items.finding: Does not say whether one Strike hitting one enemy grants one Combo gain event, or how teleporting extra strikes count.
